scams.name: The 'Free Gift' Obligation Trap
scams.setup: Vendor places an item (papyrus scrap, scarab, fan) directly into the tourist's hands, saying it's free.
scams.mechanism: Reciprocity bias - once physically holding the item, declining to pay feels socially costly.
scams.countermeasure: Don't accept items placed in your hands; hands stay in pockets/crossed near touts.

scams.name: 'Egyptian Price' Framing
scams.setup: Vendor claims a markedly high price is a special local/'Egyptian' price rather than a tourist markup.
scams.mechanism: Makes the tourist feel they've been let in on an insider deal, discouraging further negotiation.
scams.countermeasure: Research typical prices beforehand; negotiate from a fraction of the asking price regardless of framing.

scams.name: Material Counterfeiting
scams.setup: Souvenirs sold as genuine papyrus, cashmere, or silver.
scams.mechanism: Banana-leaf paper or synthetic fabric is visually similar enough to pass casual inspection.
scams.countermeasure: Buy from museum gift shops or licensed cooperatives for anything claimed to be a specific authentic material.

scams.name: Cash-Counting 'Help'
scams.setup: Vendor reaches to 'help' count bills handed over for payment.
scams.mechanism: Sleight-of-hand extracts a larger bill than owed during the 'count.'
scams.countermeasure: Count your own cash out loud, don't let anyone else touch it before the transaction is final.

scams.name: Card Terminal Overcharge
scams.setup: Paying by card; vendor enters a different amount into the terminal than agreed.
scams.mechanism: Relies on traveler not checking the screen before entering PIN/tapping.
scams.countermeasure: Always read the terminal amount before confirming payment.

scams.name: Dual Menu Pricing
scams.setup: Restaurant has an Arabic menu and a separate English menu with higher prices.
scams.countermeasure: Ask to see the same menu locals are using, or check posted prices photographed by other travelers.

scams.name: 'Pay What You Feel' Trap
scams.setup: Vendor or felucca captain refuses to name a price ('you are my friend, pay what's in your heart').
scams.mechanism: Removes a fixed number to negotiate against; any offer is met with performed offense to push for more.
scams.countermeasure: Insist on a fixed price before service begins; walk away if a vendor won't name one.
